title: MintHunt
tagline: MintHunt.io. - TreasureHunt NFT - Gems - TreasureMap - Moralis Wallet screen
description: MintHunt is a location-based mobile game/app where you can collect NFTs by physically going to their location on the map. For this hackathon I create a TreasureMap NFT that is required in order to P2E and a Gem NFT, both contracts generate on-chain SVG and metadata. These contracts were then deployed on the Polygon Mumbai testnet. I then integrated Moralis in the wallet screen in order to fetch the NFTs owned by a player.
how_its_made: The client and the system used to collect the NFTs were already created with react native and a NodeJS backend. The new TreasureMap NFT and the GemTreasure NFT were deployed on Polygon Mumbai Testnet. The wallet screen is using Moralis to fetch the NFTs that a player owns using their SDK.
